title: The Mindset Revolution
subtitle: Masterclass & Coaching Experience
summary: Understand the story you carry. Clarify what matters to you. Begin building the message, platform, or body of work you want to bring into the world.

phases.title: Personal Transformation
phases.description: Examine the language, beliefs, and experiences shaping your decisions. Build a clearer understanding of your story, values, and purpose.
activities: Complete three self-paced classes each week — all 12 classes in the first four weeks.
Bring your reflections into a private, 60-minute call each week.
Create the foundations: your language audit, growth contract, and purpose statement.

phases.title: Purpose Activation
phases.description: Choose one primary pathway and give it a clear direction. Define who you want to reach, what you want to say, and the foundations your work needs.
activities: Continue your weekly, 60-minute private coaching call.
Develop the strategy and foundational assets for your primary pathway.
Map one optional secondary pathway without dividing your main focus.

phases.title: Build the Roadmap
phases.description: Refine your chosen direction and connect the pieces. Leave with a practical roadmap for the work you will carry forward.
activities: Continue weekly private coaching, feedback, and accountability.
Refine your primary pathway and how it connects with your other ideas.
Complete your implementation plan and forward-action roadmap.

framework.title: Recognize
framework.description: See the language, beliefs, and patterns shaping your present.

framework.title: Reframe
framework.description: Look at choices, challenges, and aspirations through a more useful lens.

framework.title: Reclaim
framework.description: Recover the values, gifts, and strengths within the life you have lived.

framework.title: Rise
framework.description: Bring your insight into action, contribution, and a direction of your own.

modules.title: The Beginning of Your Next Chapter
modules.purpose: Define where you are, what you are seeking, and what may be ready to change.
modules.exercise: A personal intention for the program.

modules.title: The Language That Shapes Your Life
modules.purpose: Explore how thoughts become words, words influence actions, and repeated language shapes identity.
modules.exercise: Identify language that supports or restricts growth.

modules.title: Navigating Life’s Intersections
modules.purpose: Recognize crossroads, transitions, uncertainty, and the kind of response each moment requires.
modules.exercise: Clarify the current crossroads and next response.

modules.title: Your Personal Contract for Growth
modules.purpose: Distinguish wishes from commitments and define the principles governing future choices.

modules.title: Moving from Intention to Action
modules.purpose: Move beyond preparation and choose a meaningful step that creates momentum.
modules.exercise: Take one aligned action toward an important goal.

modules.title: Listening to the Dream
modules.purpose: Explore vision, imagination, intuition, and aspirations that continue asking for attention.

modules.title: Beyond Ego and External Validation
modules.purpose: Examine recognition, disappointment, fear, anger, and the habit of measuring worth externally.
modules.exercise: Create a more stable definition of value and success.

modules.title: The Power of Self-Service and Shared Strength
modules.purpose: Balance self-care, contribution, connection, support, and service to others.
modules.exercise: Develop a healthier model of care and contribution.

modules.title: Rewriting the Words That Limit You
modules.purpose: Identify habitual language and assumptions that close possibilities before they are explored.
modules.exercise: Replace limiting language with language of choice and inquiry.

modules.title: Remembering Through a New Lens
modules.purpose: Revisit formative experiences with the awareness and perspective available today.
modules.exercise: Reframe one experience and recognize the strength within it.

modules.title: Reclaiming Your Gifts and Purpose
modules.purpose: Identify lessons, values, capabilities, and contributions developed throughout life.
modules.exercise: Define the gifts ready to be used intentionally.

modules.title: Living from the Power Within
modules.purpose: Integrate truth, values, story, direction, and action into an authentic way of living.
modules.exercise: Complete a purpose and forward-action plan.

deliverables.title: Personal Language Audit
deliverables.description: Identify the words, beliefs, and recurring narratives to retain, revise, or release.

deliverables.title: Personal Growth Contract
deliverables.description: Set the principles and commitments that guide your choices and accountability.

deliverables.title: Purpose and Values Statement
deliverables.description: Articulate what matters to you and how you want to contribute.

deliverables.title: Personal Story Reframe
deliverables.description: Revisit formative experiences and the strengths you can recognize within them.

deliverables.title: Forward-Action Plan
deliverables.description: Define immediate actions, practices, boundaries, and the support you need.

deliverables.title: Purpose Activation Roadmap
deliverables.description: Connect your chosen pathway with a practical strategy for the work ahead.

pathways.title: Purpose and Life Direction
pathways.description: Clarify your priorities, contribution, and personal definition of meaningful progress.

pathways.title: Message and Personal Brand
pathways.description: Define whom you serve, what you teach, and what you want to be known for.

pathways.title: Speaking and Keynote Development
pathways.description: Shape your central message, stories, audience journey, call to action, and a Marquee Title that speaks to both audiences and event decision-makers.

pathways.title: Coaching or Consulting
pathways.description: Shape your experience into a clear offer, process, audience, and client journey.

pathways.title: Book and Thought Leadership
pathways.description: Develop your concept, ideal reader, title direction, structure, voice, and publication roadmap.

pathways.title: Events and Community
pathways.description: Plan the purpose, participant experience, programming, partnerships, and growth of an event or community.

pathways.title: Digital and Multimedia Presence
pathways.description: Plan your website, positioning, visual brand, speaker materials, video assets, and media presence.

pathways.title: Legacy and Impact Strategy
pathways.description: Connect your story, message, speaking, coaching, book, events, and relationships into a coherent body of work.

accessTerms: Permanent curriculum access and ongoing alumni support are subject to the written enrollment terms, including availability and continuity provisions. Review and confirm these terms before enrolling.

active: One private, 60-minute call each week for 12 weeks.
Limited email support for brief clarification, assignments, updates, and scheduling; allow up to two business days for a response.
Unused weekly calls do not accumulate.
alumni: Six complimentary, 60-minute Purpose Recalibration Sessions per calendar year after the program.
Maximum one included alumni session every two months, subject to availability.
Unused sessions expire and do not roll over.
Access is personal and non-transferable. Additional sessions may be purchased separately.
supportTerms.studio: Optional production services from Vision Digital Studio — including websites, branding, video, book support, and event production — are separately scoped, contracted, scheduled, and paid. They are not required for enrollment. Your information is shared only with your permission.
supportTerms.scope: This is coaching and education, not therapy, medical treatment, addiction treatment, or crisis care. The material may address difficult personal experiences; you may pause or skip material and seek qualified support. Private calls and email are not emergency support.
supportTerms.opportunities: Loren may suggest relevant opportunities or selected introductions based on readiness, relevance, consent, and availability. Speaking engagements, media placements, contracts, income, and other outcomes are not guaranteed.
